audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 is marked Skill and 2+ items is marked Gnar. The already-audited mirror ends on Gnar / Gnar / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Volibear, and this page's own whys already say the opposite of its sides on both rows.
audit.why: whys[1] says Mini Gnar out-pokes you at level 2, and whys[6] plus phases[6].why both say your tank-diver scaling outlives him — so the sides were the half that was wrong, not the prose.
audit.corrected: win[1]/phases[1].side -> Gnar at 3/10; win[6]/phases[6].side -> Volibear at 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: GNAR! is treated as one fixed threat, but its cooldown collapses from 90s at rank 1 to 30s at rank 3.
audit.why: Kit file: R 90/60/30. That is the real reason the lane trends away from you — by three points in his ult there is barely a window without it.
audit.corrected: Fight in the 90-second gap early; late, assume it is up.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states the wall condition on GNAR! or the range on Boomerang Throw.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Any enemy that hits a wall is stunned and takes bonus damage.' Boomerang Throw is 1100 range against your 300-range Q, and catching it reduces the cooldown from its 16s base.
audit.corrected: Fight in open ground so GNAR! only knocks up; never brawl with a wall behind you.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Mini Gnar 'kites your dive' without naming what he kites with.
audit.why: Hop is a 475-range leap on 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s, and Thundering Smash is a speed-up rather than a dash, so he simply leaves your walk-up.
audit.corrected: Hop is the escape — commit when it is spent, not when his Q is.

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. Gnar has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Q + W online, but Boomerang Throw reaches 1100 and slows — Mini Gnar pokes and steps back before your second bite lands.

edits.before: Level 3-5 Mini Gnar kites your dive with Q slow and double-strike W before your sustain lands.
edits.after: Level 3-5 Mini Gnar kites you with his Q slow and Hop, a 475-range leap on 22s at rank 1.

edits.before: - Gnar GNAR! (Mega Stun): matchup-defining — His Mega all-in. Don’t fight transform. Track it before every engage. - Gnar GNAR!: Mega only: knocks up + slows; against a wall it stuns long. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - GNAR!: matchup-defining — 90s at rank 1 but only 30s at rank 3; knocks up and slows, and stuns long if you hit a wall. Fight in open ground. - Boomerang Throw: 16s at rank 1, 1100 range, reduced when he catches it.

edits.before: His Mega all-in. Don’t fight transform. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: GNAR! is 90s at rank 1 and 30s at rank 3. Never fight him next to a wall.

edits.before: Track Gnar's GNAR! (Mega Stun): His Mega all-in. Don’t fight transform. When it is down — Q-stun + all-in him.
edits.after: GNAR! is 90s at rank 1, 30s at rank 3, and stuns long on a wall. Boomerang Throw is 16s at 1100 range.

notes: The two chart rows I flipped were already contradicted by this page's own prose, so no why text needed rewriting to match them beyond phases[1].why. Not asserted anywhere: whether Rage decays fast enough to bait a transform on purpose, or whether Stormbringer's leap can be interrupted by GNAR!'s knockup mid-flight — neither is in Riot's text and I could not verify it.
